title: Project 04 — Question Payload v1 (LOCKED v1.0)
description: LOCKED v1.0 (2026-06-09, D-PROJ04-005). The ratified question-bank data contract (R-IMP5), replacing the PROVISIONAL questionPayload $def in SCHOOLSW_ImportEnvelope_Schema. This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF RECORD for one question (QDN-01): the teacher-facing Markdown production file, master read-file, and register TSV all render from it; the app ingests it and renders display/PDF itself. It is the body that rides under envelope.payload when doc_type='question'. INTEGRATION: deliverable 5 either inlines this as the envelope's $defs.questionPayload (additionalProperties false) or external-$refs this $id; the harness runs it as the L2-for-questions pass. STANDARDS: complies with REF-09 (Tier-1 floor) / REF-10 (Tier-2 stretch), REF-17/18 (Bloom), REF-19 (topic identity — ref19_topic_id hard-validated against it), REF-22 (English vocabulary — glossary), REF-24/REF-01 C-05/C-02 (media), REF-07 §3.5 (topic-tag scheme); it redefines none of them. PEDAGOGY (QDN-06): tier / bloom_level / difficulty are orthogonal axes, so an easy-difficulty high-Bloom open item is natural to express; descriptive items carry a first-class rubric whose Islamic-alignment row is mandatory.
$comment: Draft 2020-12 to match the envelope and validate_plan.py (Draft202012Validator). House style mirrors C5_PlanSchema_v1.json: additionalProperties:false throughout, $defs for reuse, allOf+if/then on a discriminator (here question_type). Checks NOT expressible here and owed to the harness L2-for-questions pass: (a) marks == rubric total for descriptive items; (b) per-step / per-blank / per-pair breakdown sums to marks; (c) ref19_topic_id ∈ the REF-19 registry (pattern only here); (d) stimulus_ref resolves to a stored stimulus_id; (e) ENG content is Latin-pure on the rendered surface (ported ENG-LATIN rule). The 'exactly one correct MCQ option' rule IS expressed here via contains + minContains/maxContains.

qid.description: Permanent stable question id (Conventions §3), never reused. E.g. QP-BAN-C5-U13-Q01 or QP-BAN-C1-U2-L4-Q03.

topic_tag.description: Numbered topic tag (REF-07 §3.5 scheme). The register join key and the app filter key; MIRROR of envelope tags.topic_tag. Pattern-only — valid numbers come from the per-subject revision chart + REF-19, not a registry in this schema (QDN-02).

ref19_topic_id.description: REF-19 canonical topic slug, e.g. BAN-POEM / ENG-SENTSTR / BGS-ETHICS. Payload-only (NOT an envelope tag). The durable vertical-map identity; hard-validated against the REF-19 registry in the harness.

question_text.description: The stem. Authoring standard: name the chapter/poem within the wording so items are self-identifying on mixed worksheets (a build-side standard, not schema-enforceable). Content language is single-language-by-subject — Bangla, ENG excepted (QDN-07).

question_type.description: MIRROR of envelope questionPayload.question_type / vocab.ts QUESTION_TYPES. Selects the answer-carrier branch below.

paper_role.description: The REF-09 §4/§5.3 paper-section family this item is written for — a SEPARATE axis from question_type (a true_false item may serve paper_role 'mcq'). App filter for set assembly; MIRROR of envelope tags.paper_role / vocab.ts PAPER_ROLES (three-place sync).

bloom_level.description: Intended Bloom level (REF-17). MIRROR of envelope tags.bloom_level.

difficulty.description: Intended difficulty — a SEPARATE axis from Bloom (REF-09 §3). MIRROR of envelope tags.difficulty.

tier.description: tier1 = the mandatory REF-09 floor; tier2 = optional REF-10 stretch (higher-Bloom enrichment). Same payload either way.

marks.description: Item total. Half-marks allowed; no negative marking (QDN-05). For descriptive items, equals the rubric total (harness-checked).

learning_outcome_ref.description: Optional. The TG-reconciled যোগ্যতা/শিখনফল this item maps to (REF-09 alignment must #1). Internal metadata — the NCF-number surface ban does not apply here.

chapter_ref.description: Optional. Chapter/unit handle; MIRROR of envelope tags.chapter_ref.

lesson_ref.description: Optional. Lesson handle; MIRROR of envelope tags.lesson_ref.

stimulus_ref.description: Optional. References a stored stimulus doc's stimulus_id (QDN-09) when the item depends on a shared passage/poem/audio-script. Resolution is harness/app-checked, not here.

glossary.description: Optional. REF-22 receptive words glossed in the item (same content language). Keeps an item answerable rather than blocked by an unknown word.

media.description: Optional. Diagram-only references (QDN-08): non-living-being figures only. A concept needing a human/animal figure is authored as described-text instead.

rubric.description: descriptive only — criteria rubric (no single answer).

allOf.$comment: mcq -> options (exactly one correct, enforced in $defs.mcqOption parent below); forbid all other carriers.
true_false -> tf_answer; forbid all other carriers.
fill_blank -> blanks; forbid all other carriers.
matching -> pairs; forbid all other carriers.
short_answer -> answer_key; forbid all other carriers.
descriptive -> rubric; forbid all closed carriers (QDN-04 xor).

bloomLevelEN.description: Canonical English Bloom levels for app indexing (MIRROR of envelope $defs.bloomLevelEN).

option_id.description: Label (e.g. ক/খ/গ or A/B/C). Unique within the item (harness-checked).

why_wrong.description: Distractor rationale (REF-09 §5). Expected on the incorrect options.

normalized_match.description: If true, the app may match case/diacritic/whitespace-insensitively. Defaults to exact match when absent.

marks.description: Optional per-blank mark for partial credit; sums to the item marks (harness-checked).
Optional per-pair mark for partial credit.

model_note.description: Optional marker guidance / model answer note.

step_breakdown.description: Multi-step mark breakdown for consistent partial credit (REF-09 §5); sums to the item marks (harness-checked).

rubric.description: The locked REF-09 §5 open-item rubric shape. The Islamic/moral-alignment row is MANDATORY (a criterion with role 'islamic_alignment') — the standing shared-rubric standard for open items.

bands.description: Quality bands high→low, e.g. ["4","3","2","1"]. The marker maps bands to marks per the school scheme.

criteria.description: One row per criterion; MUST contain an 'islamic_alignment' row.

role.description: The criterion's role; 'islamic_alignment' is required to appear once per rubric.

band_descriptors.description: Maps each band label (from rubric.bands) to its descriptor text.

ref.description: Stored asset reference/id (the app holds the asset; no embedded blob).

alt_text.description: Required. Described-text equivalent of the figure.

curation_status.description: Author/reviewer-set REF-01 C-05/C-02 clearance. 'replaced' is reserved (only if image scope 9-B is ever opened).
